triage.notes: Cannot verify PDBot runtime behavior directly; medium confidence because PDBot depends on the cardfeed and the cardfeed fix is specifically scoped to this problem. The fix also addresses the related #8642 (gatherling scraper) issue.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed by commit 15ce8a20 (April 2022), which gave both face names for modal DFCs in the cardfeed (e.g., 'Torrent Sculptor // Flamethrower Sonata'). The current code at decksite/controllers/api.py:838-839 confirms modal_dfc cards emit both names.
